These fixtures exercise the unchanged huggingface_hub 1.5.0 implementation pinned by the reference CPU, CUDA and ROCm requirements. The wheel SHA-256 is c9c0b3ab95a777fc91666111f3b3ede71c0cdced3614c553a64e98920585c4ee. The JSONL metadata records the source-file hashes and capture dependencies. The first-party implementation, HTTP servers and test runner are C++.

hub_snapshot_cases.jsonl contains 37 real-HTTP/cache scenarios. The Python reference and C++ runner each use independent local HTTP servers and temporary cache directories. They compare returned paths, exception categories/messages, HTTP methods/paths/authentication/ranges, every regular file's bytes, symlink targets and the complete directory tree. Temporary roots and server origins are normalized. Cases include fresh downloads, reuse, mutable revisions, blob deduplication, partial-file resume, ignored ranges, complete partial files, wrong sizes, missing metadata, missing files/revisions, access failures, offline and local-only behavior, partial cached snapshots, filtering, tree fallback/pagination/failure, unwritable references, relative and CDN redirects, failed GETs, rate-limit retry and metadata retry.

The parallel case uses eight workers and three filenames sharing one blob. It checks every metadata request, one payload GET and all resulting pointers. Only concurrent event order and the interchangeable filename selected for that one shared-blob GET are normalized. Other cases use one worker to make their complete HTTP traces deterministic. The source HTTP path is selected with HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1. The external generator is /tmp/ezlocalai_hub_snapshot_oracle.py.

whisper_model_cases.jsonl contains 504 calls to the unchanged faster-whisper 1.0.3 and 1.2.0 download_model helpers. The snapshot boundary is substituted to capture alias selection, the exact file patterns/cache root, local-only retry and error propagation. Both an omitted revision and an explicit None select snapshot revision main; that default alone is normalized in the recorded call. The modern aliases include distil-large-v3.5 and turbo; the legacy aliases do not. Errors distinguish Hub HTTP errors, requests ConnectionError, HTTPX ConnectError, local cache failures and ordinary errors. hub_repository_cases.jsonl captures 30 calls to the pinned repository validator, including Unicode, length, suffix, separator and regex-final-newline behavior. The external generator is /tmp/ezlocalai_whisper_model_oracle.py.

The STT adapter now uses native local-directory/alias/snapshot resolution by default. Its existing 30 actual-model wrapper comparisons exercise both local directories and offline alias snapshots with the same verified model bytes; their provenance remains in stt_runtime_assets/README.md.

The native downloader also fetched all four permitted assets of Systran/faster-whisper-tiny.en revision 0d3d19a32d3338f10357c0889762bd8d64bbdeba from the public Hub. Configuration, model, tokenizer and vocabulary SHA-256 values exactly match the existing pinned inference assets. The isolated download lives at /tmp/ezlocalai-hub-native-live-cache; this network check is not a mandatory CTest dependency.

hub_file_cases.jsonl adds 27 scenarios executing hf_hub_download directly, with the same real HTTP/cache checks as the snapshot suite. It covers fresh/reused/updated files, blobs, resume, wrong sizes, missing metadata/files/revisions, access failures, offline/local-only/partial caches, references, redirects and GET/metadata retries. The single-file consistency error abbreviates its URL; the retained ephemeral server port is normalized along with complete origins. Other error text and cache bytes remain exact. The external generator is /tmp/ezlocalai_hub_file_oracle.py. These checks support native tokenizer fallback; its constructor and real-model fixtures are documented in whisper_tokenizer_fallback_assets/README.md.

Coverage does not establish all Hub behavior. Xet transport, proxy/TLS exception fidelity, interrupted-stream retry details, arbitrary malformed responses/filesystem errors, cross-platform behavior, all optional Hub arguments and the scheduling of downloads while a large repository tree is still being enumerated remain open. The older local-directory downloader has independent 1.28.0 fixtures and is not silently treated as verified against 1.5.0.
